_about: Public-domain Francis John McConnell (1871-1953), president of DePauw University and Methodist Episcopal bishop, for the Word Hoard: The Diviner Immanence, Christmas Sermons, Edward Gayer Andrews, Religious Certainty, The Increase of Faith, Personal Christianity, The Essentials of Methodism, Understanding the Scriptures, Democratic Christianity, Public Opinion and Theology, Church Finance and Social Ethics, The Preacher and the People, Christian Citizenship, Living Together, The Just Weight, The Christlike God, Humanism and Christianity, Borden Parker Bowne, and Human Needs and World Christianity. He lived past 1930, so only books printed before 1930 are taken. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 100 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
